title: Naval Air Station Wildwood Aviation Museum

services.name: Weddings & Private Events
services.desc: Whether you are getting married or celebrating your 50th anniversary, the NAS Wildwood Aviation Museum is happy to provide a space where you can celebrate any occasion. Spend your special day surrounded by aviation history in the museum’s World War II-era hangar! As one of the most unique wedding venues in Southern New Jersey, we offer several options for on-site ceremonies and receptions: Availability for any event is limited by seasonal constraints and prior bookings.
